title: Add support for protectedSettings to override lower priority settings
summary: Introduced a protectedSettings mechanism in AL-Go that allows organizations to prevent specific settings from being overridden by lower-priority sources unless explicitly marked as protected in those sources.
key_points: New protectedSettings array protects top-level settings from non-protected overrides
Works with both standard and conditional settings
Enables organization-level settings to enforce configuration policies
Comprehensive schema updates and documentation provided
